prompt:
Create a matching set of THREE separate Bun Do onboarding vignettes in one horizontal triptych image. Use the provided existing illustration only as a reference for the rabbit character, drawing medium and palette. Replace the original scene entirely. Three equal-width square panels in one 1536x1024 image: actually arrange THREE vignettes horizontally, centered at x=256, x=768 and x=1280, each fitting fully within its own 440x660 area, generous blank gutters between. The background across the whole image is perfectly flat paper #F8F9F4. No panel dividers. Each vignette will be cropped to its own third and shown as a standalone picture.
LEFT: Bun standing with a small plain sage notebook tucked under one forepaw and a pencil in the other, calm readiness, friendly attentive gaze. CENTER: Bun holding open a modest low timber garden gate, inviting the viewer inside, just two small moss clumps, no landscape. RIGHT: Bun and a small adult koala friend carrying a grocery basket between them, visible carrots and a baguette, both relaxed and content, working together. The koala wears a plain soft sage jacket, no crown.
Bun is the same dignified white adult rabbit martial-arts master in every vignette: compact grounded build, long upright ears with one subtly curved, defined nose, calm narrow eyes, ivory martial-arts gi, dark evergreen tied belt with visible knot, tiny restrained ochre-gold three-point crown. Quiet, lightly funny, not nursery or babyish, not Easter. Confident evergreen ink contours and subtle restrained wash, muted sage and sand accents, tiny warm ochre. All characters and objects fully visible, not cropped, no background scenery, no objects bleeding into adjacent thirds. No text, lettering, numbers, UI, logos, watermark, decorative sparkle, weapons, gradients, 3D or photorealism. Do not reproduce the app logo. Match the reference's adult-friendly storybook drawing style.
